description:
Welcome to Rainbow Valley! Become a magical unicorn stylist and care for more than 60 adorable unicorns across 12 enchanted lands.

600 LEVELS, 5 WAYS TO PLAY
• Unicorn salon: bubble bath with real foam, rinse, blow-dry, brush out tangled manes, polish the horn and clean muddy hooves
• Mane makeover: rainbow spray, glitter, 12 paint colors and 6 hairstyles including braids, curls, buns and ponytails
• Makeup and dress up: blush, eye shadow, face stickers, crowns, flower crowns, bows, wings, saddles, capes and necklaces
• Coloring book: 120 coloring pages with fill, brush, glitter, gradient, pattern and rainbow tools
• Color by number: 60 calm number paintings for little artists
• Rainbow flight: fly through the clouds, collect stars, pass through rainbow rings, ride the wind and light up the dark with a lantern
• Memory cards: find matching unicorns and magic charms, from 3 to 8 pairs
• Every unicorn customer has a wish. Match the requested mane color, hairstyle or accessory to earn 3 stars!

COLLECT AND DECORATE
• Hatch magic eggs and collect 60 baby unicorns
• Decorate a cozy unicorn stable
• Fill a sticker album with 600 unique stickers
• A free surprise egg every day

12 MAGICAL LANDS
Cloud Kingdom, Candy Land, Flower Garden, Crystal Caves, Butterfly Forest, Ocean Lagoon, Snow Land, Moonlight Woods, Star Space, Fruit Orchard, Sunset Hills and the Rainbow Palace.

SIMPLE AND SAFE
• Picture-based controls, no reading needed
• No ads
• Plays offline after the first launch
• A parental gate protects purchases and settings
• No personal data collected
• Sound on/off button on every screen

PREMIUM AND PURCHASES
Most of the valley is free to play. Optional purchases: Premium (monthly subscription that unlocks every land and pack), Unlock Everything (one-time), and the Crystal Caves, Ocean Lagoon and Star Space packs.

Subscription: Premium renews automatically every month unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Microsoft account at confirmation of purchase. Manage or cancel at account.microsoft.com/services.

Privacy Policy: https://mucobulut.github.io/oyunlar-destek/unicornsalon/privacy/
short: 600 levels in 12 magical lands: salon makeovers, coloring, rainbow flights, memory cards and 60 baby unicorns to hatch.
